title: Crimson Rose in Desolation
description: A massive, blood-red rose with dark green leaves covered in glowing arcane runes stands prominently in a barren desert landscape. In the dramatic sky above, a giant red celestial body glows near the horizon while white smoke rises from the center of the flower.
prompt: A colossal blood-red rose with intricate glowing runes and symbols covering its dark green leaves and petals, rising from a barren rocky desert with ancient ruins and jagged rock formations in the background. A massive glowing red celestial body dominates the dark teal sky, white smoke drifting from the flower, dramatic cinematic lighting, surreal fantasy atmosphere.
